measurement: accepted_milestones/10; coarse planning coverage, not production readiness

milestones.title: Source and product contract
milestones.acceptance: A source/access register separates existing evidence from plans; brief has bounded user/problem/non-goals, acceptance criteria and data-rights/gaps.

milestones.title: Architecture and experiment plan
milestones.acceptance: Reviewed module/data schemas, failure cases, deterministic test strategy, dependencies, license/consent plan and one ADR; no implementation credit for empty headings.

milestones.title: Executable offline scaffold
milestones.acceptance: Fresh environment instructions, smallest working CLI/scorer/validator, honest synthetic fixture and at least two meaningful tests with saved output; no network required.

milestones.title: One real end-to-end vertical slice
milestones.acceptance: One project-specific core workflow executes against cleared inputs with outputs and regression tests; mock audio is labeled and cannot count as a real TTS model baseline.

milestones.title: Dataset/fixture expansion
milestones.acceptance: Reviewed versioned case collection, sources/rights, splits and edge cases; synthetic and empirical data remain distinguishable.

milestones.title: Baseline evaluation
milestones.acceptance: Reproducible metrics with denominators, limitations and measured actual baselines; no invented gains.

milestones.title: Robustness and error analysis
milestones.acceptance: Targeted failure analysis, adversarial/malformed cases, disagreement handling and relevant fixes verified.

milestones.title: Packaging and CI
milestones.acceptance: Installable minimal package or static demo, locked/documented dependencies, focused CI and reproducible examples.

milestones.title: Representation and website export
milestones.acceptance: Accurate native diagram, readable editorial project page, optional generated image with provenance, accessible portable site payload.

milestones.title: Release and independent review
milestones.acceptance: Privacy/licensing/security checks, independent review, contribution statement, honest README, known issues and reviewed release decision.
